name: jagir-mcp
description: Search and compare stays on Jabama, Jajiga and Otaghak (Iran). Read-only.
long_description: Jagir (جاگیر) searches Jabama, Jajiga and Otaghak in one go: prices in Toman, Gregorian or Jalali dates, full stay details with cleanliness and other sub-ratings, complete guest reviews, availability calendars and price quotes. It never logs in or books anything.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Match a city or area name on each platform.

tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search all three platforms at once and compare prices.

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: Full stay detail: amenities, rules, beds, ratings breakdown, photos.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Complete guest reviews with host replies.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Total price for given dates and guests.
